map.由后视前视累计求待定点高程 使用指南: Elevation of a Point from Backsight and Foresight Totals User Guide
map.输入已知点高程 BM、后视累计 BS 与前视累计 FS，按 RL=BM+ΣBS−: Enter the known point elevation BM, the backsight total BS and the foresight total FS, and the elevation follows from RL=BM+ΣBS−ΣFS.
map.输入已知点高程 BM、后视累计 BS 与前视累计 FS，求高程。: Enter the known point elevation BM, the backsight total BS and the foresight total FS to get the elevation.
map.填写「已知点高程 BM (米)」。: Enter the known point elevation BM (metres).
map.由已知 BM 与后/前视算各点 RL。: Compute the RL of each point from the known BM and the backsight and foresight readings.
map.逐站传递高程。: Passes the elevation from station to station.
map.：BM=100.000，Σ后视=3.500、Σ前视=1.200 → 末点 RL=: BM=100.000, Σbacksight=3.500, Σforesight=1.200 → the final point RL=100+3.500−1.200=102.300m.
map.：附合到另一已知点时，计算值与已知值差=闭合差，限差内平差。: When closing back onto another known point, the difference between the computed value and the known value is the closure error, adjusted within the tolerance.
map.纵坡 = 高差 / 平距: Longitudinal slope = elevation difference / horizontal distance
map.由横基尺长度与夹角求距离: Distance from a horizontal baseline and the included angles
map.RL=BM+ΣBS−ΣFS（或本站 RL=上站 RL+后视−前视）。: RL=BM+ΣBS−ΣFS (or on this site RL = previous station RL + backsight − foresight).
map.后前视顺序？: What is the backsight and foresight order?
map.每站读后视定仪高再读前视得前点高，顺序错则整条错。: At each station read the backsight to get the instrument height and then the foresight to get the next point; getting the order wrong spoils the whole run.
